title: 15 Notice for Main Examination of Junior Clerks under PACS and OCS quota View

source.name: Himachal Pradesh State Co-operative Bank Ltd. (hpscb), Himachal Pradesh

text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 18.07.2024 ---sd---

FULL TEXT:
Main Examination Notice for the candidates who have applied for
the posts of Jr. Clerks under PACS/OCS Quota.
In reference to online applications received for the posts of Jr. Clerks under society quota
i.e. under PACS Quota as well as under OCS Quota, in the Bank; all applicants are informed
that online MAIN EXAMINATION for said posts has been scheduled to be conducted by
IBPS on 28TH July, 2024. The candidates are advised to download their call letters for ibid
online exam from the link provided on Bank’s website www.hpscb.com .
The candidates are also advised to read and follow all the instructions given in their call
letters and information handout, meticulously, to avoid any inconvenience at examination
venue.
Date: 18.07.2024 ---sd---
Place: Shimla Managing Director
